description:
The 2020 Bentley Flying Spur W12 is the first model year of the third-generation Flying Spur, which brought a new level of performance, technology, and craftsmanship to Bentley s four-door grand touring sedan. This Flying Spur is finished in satin black with blacked-out exterior details and rides on 22-inch aftermarket wheels. Inside, a bold red leather interior with diamond quilting, 3D diamond-textured door panels, and black accents creates a striking contrast with the dark exterior.

Power comes from Bentley s hand-assembled 6.0-liter twin-turbocharged W12 engine, producing 626 horsepower and 664 lb-ft of torque. Power is delivered through an eight-speed dual-clutch transmission to an active all-wheel-drive system that can shift torque between the axles as conditions change. The Flying Spur W12 reaches 60 mph in approximately 3.7 seconds and has a top speed of 207 mph, which places it among the fastest luxury sedans in the world.

The chassis combines comfort and agility. Three-chamber adaptive air suspension with four-corner auto-leveling smooths the road at any speed. Bentley Dynamic Ride uses a 48-volt active anti-roll system to keep the body flat through corners, and electronic all-wheel steering makes the car feel smaller and more maneuverable at low speeds while adding stability at highway speeds. The drive dynamics selector offers Bentley, Comfort, Sport, and Custom modes, so the driver can tailor the car from relaxed long-distance cruising to sharper, more responsive handling.

The exterior is dark and purposeful. The satin black finish is paired with a gloss black vertical-vane front grille, gloss black matrix lower grilles and intake surrounds, black side vents, black window surrounds, and black oval exhaust outlets. The black retractable Flying B hood mascot sits above the grille, and the signature crystal-cut LED matrix headlamps stand out against the dark bodywork. The car rides on 22-inch black aftermarket wheels with an intricate lattice-spoke design, gloss black outer lips, and Bentley center caps. They are wrapped in Michelin Pilot Sport 4 S tires, and red brake calipers show through the spokes.

Inside, the Flying Spur is finished in two shades of red leather. Bright red bolsters frame deep red quilted and perforated seat inserts, and an embroidered Bentley winged B emblem sits on every seat. The front door panels feature red 3D diamond-textured leather, while the rear doors pair red lower panels with black 3D diamond-textured upper sections. Black leather covers the upper dashboard, center console, and armrests, with red contrast stitching throughout. A red headliner with suede-style accent panels runs beneath a large glass sunroof, and piano black veneer, knurled chrome controls, and an analog Bentley clock complete the interior.

This 2025 BMW 7 Series 760i xDrive represents the pinnacle of luxury sedan craftsmanship, delivering a commanding presence with its sophisticated black exterior and refined engineering.

- Highway Assistant with hands-off driving capability up to 85mph on closed access highways
- Driving Assistance Professional Package including ACC with Stop & Go and Active Lane Keeping Assistant
- BMW Individual Composition with Carbon Fiber Trim, Silver Thread accents, and Piano Black finishes

The interior showcases BMW Individual craftsmanship with exclusive contents, presenting a luxurious environment where every surface reflects attention to detail. The coordinated Alcantara headliner complements the full Merino leather appointments, while carbon fiber trim with silver threading adds modern sophistication to the driving space.

Advanced technology seamlessly integrates into your daily driving experience. The Heads-Up Display presents critical information directly in your line of sight, while Live Cockpit Pro with BMW Maps Navigation ensures intuitive connectivity. Your vehicle communicates with your digital world through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, and ConnectedDrive Services keeps you connected to what matters.

For those who value both comfort and capability on the road, the adaptive suspension system and speed-sensing steering adapt to your driving conditions in real time. The Parking Assistant Professional with 3D Surround View transforms challenging parking scenarios into manageable moments, while the drive recorder captures your journeys.

Your safety is paramount, supported by a comprehensive suite of airbags, electronic stability control, and an emergency communication system. The anti-whiplash front head restraints and power adjustable front head restraints demonstrate BMW's commitment to protective engineering.

This 2025 BMW 7 Series 760i xDrive awaits your visit to our showroom, where you can experience firsthand the convergence of luxury, technology, and performance.

description:
The 2025 BMW M3 Competition is a high-performance sport sedan that combines track-inspired engineering with the comfort, technology, and everyday usability expected from a BMW. With aggressive styling, tremendous power, precision handling, and a premium interior, the M3 Competition delivers an exhilarating driving experience without sacrificing practicality.

Power comes from a 3.0-liter BMW M TwinPower Turbo inline-6 engine producing 503 horsepower and 479 lb-ft of torque in the rear-wheel-drive Competition model. The engine is paired with an 8-speed M Steptronic automatic transmission and delivers rapid acceleration with strong power throughout the rev range. The available M xDrive all-wheel-drive version increases output to 523 horsepower and adds enhanced traction and launch capability. Selectable driving modes allow the driver to adjust throttle response, transmission behavior, steering, suspension, and other performance characteristics.

The M3 Competition features an aggressively sculpted exterior designed to emphasize its performance character. Signature M styling includes the large vertical kidney grille, muscular fenders, aerodynamic bodywork, quad exhaust outlets, and distinctive M badging. Available features can include carbon fiber exterior components, adaptive LED headlights, a carbon fiber roof, and performance-focused wheel and tire packages.

Inside, the cabin blends luxury with a distinctly driver-focused design. Supportive sport seats help keep occupants secure during spirited driving while providing comfort for everyday use. Available features include Merino leather upholstery, heated and ventilated front seats, carbon fiber interior trim, a heated M steering wheel, and customizable ambient lighting. The sedan's four-door layout and usable rear seating make the M3 Competition practical enough for daily driving.

Technology is integrated throughout the cabin, highlighted by BMW's curved display combining the digital instrument cluster with a large central touchscreen. Features include BMW iDrive, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Bluetooth, navigation, USB connectivity, and available premium Harman Kardon or Bowers & Wilkins audio systems depending on configuration. BMW's driver-focused interface keeps performance information and vehicle settings easily accessible.

The M3 Competition is engineered with performance in mind, featuring M-tuned suspension, powerful M Sport brakes, variable-ratio steering, an electronically controlled Active M Differential, and sophisticated chassis electronics. Available carbon-ceramic brakes and additional M performance options can further enhance braking and track capability. Despite its performance focus, the M3 remains composed and comfortable enough for highway cruising and everyday errands.

Advanced driver-assistance features are also available, including frontal collision warning, automatic emergency braking, lane departure warning, blind spot monitoring, adaptive cruise control, and parking assistance depending on equipment.

With its turbocharged inline-6 power, available M xDrive all-wheel drive, precision chassis tuning, aggressive M styling, advanced technology, and premium four-door interior, the 2025 BMW M3 Competition is a performance sedan built to deliver exceptional driving excitement while remaining practical enough for everyday life.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

description: 2022 Lucid Air Dream Edition Performance Experience extraordinary electric performance and sophisticated luxury with this 2022 Lucid Air Dream Edition Performance. A dramatic glass canopy roof extends over the passenger compartment, creating a bright and spacious atmosphere while contributing to the Air's sleek appearance. Inside, the Santa Monica cabin showcases Lucid's emphasis on craftsmanship and modern luxury. Premium Nappa full-grain leather upholstery creates an upscale environment, while the front seats feature heating, ventilation, and massage functionality for exceptional comfort. Technology takes center stage with Lucid's expansive 34-inch Glass Cockpit display, providing the driver with a sophisticated digital interface for instrumentation, navigation, entertainment, connectivity, and vehicle information. This 2022 Tesla Model S Plaid in Deep Blue Metallic with a Cream interior is available now at Way Scarff Ford in Auburn, Washington. We're a family-owned dealer since 1922, serving Kent, Federal Way, Puyallup, Tacoma, Seattle, and the greater Puget Sound. It has 54,652 miles and the steering yoke, plus two extra-cost Tesla choices: the blue paint and the Cream interior. If you've wanted the quickest Model S Tesla builds, this is a good place to start.

The Plaid uses three electric motors with all-wheel drive and torque vectoring, and Tesla rates it at 1,020 horsepower. Tesla's published 0-60 mph time is 1.99 seconds (with rollout subtracted), with a 9.23-second quarter mile. Drag Strip mode and Track mode are built in, and the adaptive air suspension adjusts ride height and firmness. Regenerative braking uses the motors to slow the car, which reduces brake wear. With no gas engine, there are no oil changes. Routine care is mostly tires, the cabin air filter, wiper blades, and washer fluid.

Inside, a 17-inch tilting center touchscreen, a 12.3-inch driver display, and an 8-inch rear display handle navigation, media, and climate. The onboard computer supports games with a compatible wireless controller, and Theater mode streams video while you're parked or charging. Tesla's 22-speaker, 960-watt audio system with Active Road Noise Reduction is standard, as are the glass roof, a rear view camera, and over-the-air software updates. The built-in trip planner routes you through Tesla's Supercharger network and shows your expected charge at each stop and at your destination.

The liftback design makes it practical. The rear seats fold to open up the cargo area, there's a removable cargo cover and a sub-trunk under the floor, and the front trunk adds more storage. It also carries the balance of Tesla's 8-year/150,000-mile Battery and Drive Unit Limited Warranty, based on the original in-service date. It's a strong pick for Puget Sound commuters and anyone who wants supercar acceleration in a usable sedan.

Convenience
  • Unresponsive driver assistant - a reaction to inaction. Maybe you fell asleep. Maybe you lost consciousness. No matter how it happens, Unresponsive driver assistant works to help lessen the danger when it does. It detects prolonged driver unresponsiveness, automatically bringing the vehicle to a stop and turning on the hazard lights. If equipped, emergency services will also be contacted. Unresponsive driver assistant is safety that never sleeps.
Safety and Security
  • Night vision - Lift the veil of darkness. We've all been there, it's dark, and suddenly something appears out of nowhere in the road! With this safety feature, the night no longer holds unpleasant surprises. Working in combination with the headlights, night vision uses infrared technology to detect obstacles in the dark and show them on your display screen. Night vision makes for a safer drive between dusk and dawn.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

This 2024 BMW 7 Series 740i represents the pinnacle of luxury sedan engineering, offering a commanding driving experience with refined performance and advanced technology integrated throughout every aspect of the vehicle.

- Front ventilated seats
- Extended Merino leather upholstery in black
- Premium Package with ACC Stop & Go and Active Driving Assistant
- Parking Assistant Professional with 3D Surround View
- 18-speaker Bowers & Wilkins surround sound system
- SiriusXM 360L with one year Platinum Plan subscription
- BMW Curved Display with integrated heads-up display
- Adaptive suspension with auto-leveling capability
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Connected Package Pro with BMW Maps Navigation
- Multi-functional heated and ventilated front seats
- 20-inch M Aerodynamic bi-color style wheels
- Heated steering wheel with memory function
- Front and rear heated seats
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering

The 740i is powered by a 3.0-liter inline-six engine with TwinPower turbo technology and eight-speed automatic Sport transmission, delivering responsive acceleration paired with efficiency ratings of 25 city and 31 highway miles per gallon. The rear-wheel-drive configuration ensures precise handling and confident cornering on every road surface.

Step inside and experience an environment crafted for ultimate comfort and control. The extended Merino leather upholstery, finished in black, wraps premium seating surfaces that feature both heating and ventilation capabilities. Multi-functional front bucket seats with memory recall functions allow you to customize your driving position, while the rear seat center armrest and heated rear seats provide exceptional comfort for all passengers.

Technology and convenience define the 740i's interior experience. The curved display presents critical driving information with intuitive controls, while the heads-up display projects essential data directly into your line of sight. Personal eSIM 5G connectivity enables seamless integration with your digital life, and CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility ensure your smartphone functions as a natural extension of the vehicle's systems.

Safety and assistance features work together to support confident driving in any condition. The Parking Assistant Professional system with 3D Surround View simplifies maneuvering in tight spaces, while ACC Stop & Go with Active Driving Assistant helps manage traffic flow. A comprehensive airbag system, electronic stability control, and anti-whiplash front head restraints protect occupants throughout your journey.

The exterior presentation combines elegance with athleticism. The black finish is complemented by 20-inch M Aerodynamic bi-color style wheels and body-color bumpers. Auto-dimming mirrors with heating functionality, fully automatic headlights with auto high-beam capability, and rain-sensing wipers ensure optimal visibility in all weather conditions.

This carefully maintained 740i awaits your inspection. Schedule a visit to experience the commanding presence, refined capability, and technological sophistication that define BMW's flagship sedan. Our team is prepared to discuss how this vehicle aligns with your expectations for luxury motoring.

2025 Honda Accord Sedan SE CVT — 1.5L I-4 gasoline direct injection, DOHC, i-VTEC variable valve control, intercooled turbo, regular unleaded, 192HP CVT. The SE pairs a turbocharged 1.5-liter four-cylinder with a continuously variable transmission to deliver spirited yet efficient performance, offering a composed ride and a comfortable cabin well suited to daily commutes and longer drives.

Smart device mirroring projects compatible phone apps and navigation onto the Accord’s touchscreen so you can access music, directions and messages more safely and with less distraction while on the road.

Hands-on steering assist with lane centering helps keep the car steady in its lane on highways, easing driver workload during long stretches while still requiring your attention for safety.

Forward collision mitigation constantly scans ahead and can ready the vehicle or intervene if a frontal impact appears likely, providing an automated safety layer to help avoid or reduce crash severity.

Front pedestrian impact prevention improves detection of people near the roadway and can take proactive steps to avoid or lessen collisions with pedestrians in busy or unpredictable situations.

A built-in mobile hotspot transforms the cabin into a portable Wi-Fi zone so passengers can stream, browse or work without relying entirely on individual data plans.

The rear camera gives a clearer view behind the vehicle to simplify reversing and parking, helping you spot obstacles and hazards that might otherwise be difficult to see.

Lane departure prevention applies corrective steering or braking if the Accord begins to drift from its lane unintentionally, adding an extra safeguard when attention lapses.

Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go maintains a set distance from the vehicle ahead and can bring the car to a stop in slow traffic, then resume automatically—reducing stress in congested commutes.

Brake assist senses panic stops and applies maximum available braking force to help shorten stopping distances when rapid deceleration is needed.

Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls keeps speed adjustments at your fingertips, helping reduce fatigue on long drives while maintaining steady highway pace.

Altogether, the 2025 Honda Accord Sedan SE CVT blends efficient turbocharged power, modern connectivity and a suite of driver aids to create a practical, comfortable midsize sedan that’s easy to live with—visit your local dealer to see how it fits your daily driving needs.
